questions.question: Which Jack Ryan film does Harrison Ford not appear in?
choices: All of them. He never played Jack Ryan
questions.note: Alec Baldwin is Ryan in The Hunt for Red October (1990). Ford took over for Patriot Games and Clear and Present Danger.

questions.question: In Patriot Games, what is the name of Ford’s CIA analyst?
questions.note: Tom Clancy’s hero. Ford plays him as a family man who cannot stay at a desk.

questions.question: Who plays IRA operative Sean Miller, the villain in Patriot Games?
questions.note: Bean, before the Game of Thrones fame. Roth was in Reservoir Dogs the same year, not this.

questions.question: Who created the Jack Ryan novels that Ford’s films adapt?
questions.note: Patriot Games and Clear and Present Danger. The Hunt for Red October was the first filmed Clancy book.

questions.question: Who plays black-ops man John Clark in Clear and Present Danger?
questions.note: Dafoe in the field, Ford in Washington. James Earl Jones is Admiral Greer in the Baldwin and Ford Ryan films.

questions.question: In Air Force One, what is the name of Ford’s U.S. president?
questions.note: Shepherd is Michael Douglas in The American President. Beck is Dean in The West Wing movie Deep Impact. Heller is 24.

questions.question: What is Ford’s famous line as President Marshall in Air Force One?
choices: I picked a bad day to stop sniffing glue
questions.note: He throws Gary Oldman’s hijacker off the back ramp. Wolfgang Petersen directed, 1997.

questions.question: Who plays the hijacker Ivan Korshunov in Air Force One?
questions.note: Oldman as a Kazakh terrorist. Glenn Close is the vice president on the ground.

questions.question: Who directed Air Force One?
questions.note: Petersen also made Das Boot and The Perfect Storm. Noyce directed both of Ford’s Jack Ryan films.

questions.question: Who plays Cathy Ryan, Jack’s wife, in Ford’s two Jack Ryan films?
questions.note: Archer was also in Fatal Attraction. Scacchi is in Presumed Innocent; Bening is in Regarding Henry.
